channels.name: Container images (GHCR)
channels.update: The release workflow publishes signed server and render worker images for each Work release tag.
channels.open: Runtime qualification of the render worker's arm64 image; the server's arm64 image passes only the CI container qualification.

attempts.note: Signed amd64 and arm64 images; both digests in release.json resolve without signing in.

channels.name: Helm chart repository
channels.update: Dispatch Publish official Helm chart with the reviewed main SHA; every chart change needs a new chart version.
channels.open: First publication of chart 0.3.2, anonymous download and signature checks, then a live Rancher installation and upgrade.

channels.name: Artifact Hub
channels.update: Artifact Hub indexes each new chart version from the Helm chart repository.
channels.open: A project organisation and repository, then Verified publisher, then Official status.

channels.name: Neutral Compose package (VM or private server)
channels.update: Regenerate with node scripts/marketplace-packages.ts after a reviewed change to release.json; operators replace the package files to upgrade.
channels.open: An installed cross-version upgrade and recovery on a second host.

attempts.note: CI boots the pinned package, signs in, exports, restarts and restores its database.

channels.name: UpCloud quick start
channels.update: The UpCloud infrastructure module plus the neutral Compose package; it follows each package update.
channels.open: An installed cross-version upgrade, recovery on a second host, organisation OIDC and a boot through the infrastructure module.

attempts.note: Reference installation on Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 in Frankfurt, created through the provider API.

channels.name: Evroc quick start
channels.update: The Evroc infrastructure module plus the neutral Compose package.
channels.open: Boot and application acceptance on an Evroc account.

channels.name: YunoHost package (beta)
channels.update: Mirror deploy/yunohost to lolly-work_ynh and tag it, for example v1.1.1-ynh1, after its runtime checks.
channels.open: Runtime acceptance (the 1.1.1 run fails its level check), arm64 installation; the beta label stays.

attempts.note: Beta tag; its pinned archives download. All seven package tests passed on amd64 Bookworm.

channels.name: YunoHost app catalogue
channels.update: A YunoHost/apps pull request registers the package; the catalogue then follows the referenced package repository.
channels.open: Catalogue registration, which waits for a maintainer's authorisation.

channels.name: Dokploy templates
channels.update: Copy deploy/dokploy/lolly-work to blueprints/lolly-work in a Dokploy/templates pull request; later versions use the same repository.
channels.open: Isolated Dokploy import and acceptance, a second-version installed upgrade, then the catalogue pull request.
